findings: Owner request 2026-11-10: practice short questions for Unit 7 in the same format as the other books' chapter practice, long questions in the Mathematics Board Section-II shape (5-mark parts) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the unit; not printed in the book. 42 questions numbered 1-42; by section: 7.1 2, 7.1.1 2, 7.1.2 4, 7.1.3 9, 7.1.4 5, 7.1.5 5, 7.1.6 9, 7.1.7 6.

Covers 7.1 and 7.1.1-7.1.7 in book order: definitions, unit conversion, distance/displacement and speed/velocity (as tables), average and instantaneous velocity, acceleration (also a = v dv/dx), reading displacement-time and velocity-time graphs, area under the graph, the derivations of the equations of motion, variable acceleration by integration and free vertical motion, all with new data; no exercise question or book example is repeated. Book corrections followed (return trip: displacement 0, distance not 0; a = -g and v = u - gt upward). Every answer was checked by computation (sympy, check7.py).
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
